notes: Backups: 'Export everything' (addons + all their settings, keybinds, macros and hand-installed addons in one file) and 'Restore from file…' for a new PC. Optional sync folder (OneDrive/Dropbox) keeps two PCs in step — the other PC offers to restore, nothing happens by itself. Lua-errors dialog: 'Report ↗' opens the addon's bug tracker with the errors filled in.
